title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Section 3 Residue and IANA Registry Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback tests, requirement-home trace assertions, and SpecTrace JSON validation for the remaining RFC 9250 section 3 residue and section 8 registry-governance slice.
scope: This verification covers the large-response DoQ stream proof, the ALPN byte-sequence proof, the TLS transport mapping trace, the registry values, the unknown/reserved normalization behavior, and the registry-governance documentation for RFC 9250 sections 3 and 8. It does not add a custom DoQ datagram or PMTU layer.
preconditions: The managed QUIC loopback transport is available for stream-path verification.
The DoQ adapter remains stream-based and transport-backed.
expected_result: The focused DoQ stream, ALPN, and registry-governance tests pass; the trace artifacts validate cleanly; and the slice remains documentation-first without any custom transport layer.
status_summary: The large-response DoQ stream proof, ALPN byte-sequence proof, and registry-governance trace checks passed.
